blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: LLMs trained with Chain-of-thought excel in reasoning capability, but often come with excessive token cost. We find that the core of reasoning capacity lies in the Thinking model’s weight component within the null space of a projection defined by the corresponding Non-thinking model’s dominant singular directions, and removing the subspace component can largely improve reasoning efficiency without hurting the accuracy gained during thinking-mode post-training. Unlike existing efforts that mostly operate within the dominant subspace, we are the first to unveil the critical role of the null space and harness it for model optimization. Motivated by this finding, we propose Spectral Null-Space Swap ( S 3 S^{3} ), a training-free composition of paired Non-thinking and Thinking checkpoints. Our method keeps the Non-thinking model inside its own dominant subspace and takes the Thinking checkpoint outside it, improving reasoning efficiency while maintaining accuracy. We extensively evaluate S 3 S^{3} on 2B–30B dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures spanning 28 evaluation environments across mathematical, multimodal, and audio reasoning domains . S 3 S^{3} establishes new empirical Pareto Frontiers among training-free model composition strategies: across all settings, it reduces inference token overhead by an average of 27.4% compared to full Thinking models while simultaneously improving overall task accuracy by 1.0 percentage point (e.g., yielding +8.3% accuracy on HMMT25 alongside a 33.0% token speedup). We further use attention entropy for explanation and find that the retained component produces more concentrated attention, and we use a simplified analytical model about optimization to demonstrate why null-space can effectively reduce attention entropy, thereby improving the efficiency of reasoning.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Scaling language models enabled few-shot adaptation [ 1 ] , instruction tuning aligned them with user intent [ 2 ] , and chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting made reasoning explicit [ 3 ] . Recent models extend deliberate reasoning across text, vision, and audio [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] , while agents interleave reasoning with actions and observations [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 ] to handle extended interactions, multi-agent coordination, and sequential decision-making [ 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 ] . However, overly lengthy CoT imposes heavy computational costs as workloads scale, making efficient reasoning essential.
blocks.zh: 扩展语言模型可以进行几发改编[1],指令调整使其符合用户意图[2],启发思维链(COT)使推理明确[3]。 最近的模型在文本、愿景和音频[4、5、6]之间扩展了审慎的推理,而代理人则将推理与行动和观察[7、8、9、10、11、12] 联系起来,以处理扩展的相互作用、多代理协调和顺序决策[13、14、15、16、17、18]。 然而,过度冗长的COT将沉重的计算费用作为工作量的尺度,因此有效的推理至关重要。

blocks.en: Post-training—especially reinforcement learning in thinking mode—improves reasoning through multi-domain fine-tuning, policy optimization, and reward modeling [ 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 ] , but inevitably inflates token consumption. Prior work explores explicit budgets [ 25 ] , adaptive stopping, token pruning, and weight interpolation to balance accuracy and efficiency. Nevertheless, a core question remains: where in weight space does a Thinking model differ functionally from its Non-thinking counterpart, and which part of that difference can be removed without incurring full generation costs?
blocks.zh: 培训后——特别是在思维模式方面的强化学习——通过多领域微调、政策优化和奖励模式[19、20、21、22、23、24]改进推理,但不可避免地夸大象征性消费。 先前的工作探索了明确的预算[25]、适应性停止、象征性推算和加权内插,以平衡准确性和效率。 尽管如此,一个核心问题仍然是:思维模式在重量空间中与非思维对应模式在功能上有什么不同,其中哪部分差异可以在不产生全部生成成本的情况下消除?

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Efficient Reasoning and Chain-of-Thought Compression
blocks.zh: 2.1 高效的理性和思维链压缩

blocks.en:
Chain-of-thought (CoT) improves LLM reasoning but increases decoding cost. Existing approaches address this trade-off through adaptive computation and post-training, including adaptive stopping, token pruning, partial verification, process-reward learning, and reinforcement-learning-based optimization [ 26 , 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 , 31 , 32 , 33 , 34 ] .
In contrast, our method operates directly in weight space: it preserves the Non-thinking model in a protected spectral subspace and transfers only the complementary component from its corresponding Thinking model. This retains the Thinking model’s reasoning capability while reducing CoT overhead, without additional training or decoding changes.
blocks.zh:
思维链(CoT)改进了LLM推理,但增加了解码成本. 现有办法通过适应性计算和培训后处理这种取舍,包括适应性停止、象征性检查、部分核查、过程奖励学习和基于强化的学习优化[26、27、28、29、30、31、32、33、34]。
相比之下,我们的方法直接在重量空间中运作:它保留了受保护的光谱子空间中的非思维模型,并且只从相应的思维模型中传输互补组件. 这保留了思维模型的推理能力,同时减少了CoT的间接费用,而没有额外的训练或解码变化.

blocks.en: 2.2 Weight-Space Model Composition and Spectral Subspace Transfer
blocks.zh: 2.2 重量-空间模型构成和光谱子空间转移

blocks.en:
Weight-space merging combines fine-tuned models without retraining, evolving from checkpoint averaging and task arithmetic to interference reduction via sign resolution and delta sparsification [ 35 , 36 , 37 , 38 ] . For efficient reasoning, direct Non-thinking–Thinking interpolation offers an accuracy–cost trade-off without extra training [ 39 ] .
Spectral methods exploit parameter subspaces, including task-matrix analysis, LoRA-SVD alignment, shared/task-specific subspace separation, and base-aligned RL update decomposition [ 40 , 41 , 42 , 43 ] .
Our approach instead preserves the Non-thinking model’s leading spectral subspace while transferring only the complementary component from the Thinking model, using Non-thinking as an anchor and Thinking as a capability donor for selective reasoning transfer rather than multi-task fusion.
blocks.zh:
重量-空间合并结合了未经再培训的微调模式,从检查站平均值和任务算术发展到通过标志解析和三角溅射减少干扰[35、36、37、38]。 为了高效的推理,直接的不思考-考虑插图提供了准确性-成本权衡而不额外培训[39].
光谱方法利用参数子空间,包括任务组合分析,LORA-SVD对齐,共享/任务特定子空间分离,以及基础对齐的RL更新分解[40,41,42,43].
相反,我们的方法保留了非思考模型的主要光谱子空间,而仅将互补部分从思维模型中转移,将非思考作为锚点,将思考作为选择性推理转移而不是多任务组合的能力捐赠者。

blocks.en: 2.3 Attention Entropy and Reasoning Dynamics
blocks.zh: 2.3 注意和理性动态

blocks.en:
Attention entropy characterizes attention concentration and has been linked to Transformer attention dynamics and geometry [ 44 , 45 , 46 ] . Recent work further relates attention entropy to reasoning dynamics and chain-of-thought trajectories [ 47 , 48 , 49 , 50 ] .
We observe consistent reductions in attention entropy across models and datasets, consistent with prior studies linking more concentrated attention patterns to effective contextual processing and reasoning, as well as recent work relating entropy dynamics to reasoning efficiency [ 47 , 51 , 52 ] . Beyond this empirical observation, we provide the first theoretical analysis connecting null-space projection in parameter space to attention entropy.
blocks.zh:
注意力 en是注意力集中的特点,与变形器注意力动态和几何[44,45,46]有关. 最近的工作进一步将注意的entropy与推理动力学和思维链轨迹[47,48,49,50].
我们注意到,各模型和数据集的注意力均不断减少,这与以前将注意力更加集中的规律与有效的背景处理和推理联系起来的研究以及最近与推理效率有关的研究一致[47、51、52]。 除了这个经验性观察之外,我们提供了第一个理论分析,将参数空间的空空投射与注意力 en联系起来.

blocks.en: 3 Method: Spectral Null-Space Swap
blocks.zh: 3 方法:光谱 Null-Space 交换

blocks.en: This section develops the method in three steps. Section 3.1 asks where a Thinking model differs from its Non-thinking counterpart in weight space, finding that functional differences lie mostly outside the Non-thinking model’s occupied directions. Section 3.2 converts this finding into an operator that preserves the Non-thinking model’s leading spectral directions while importing the remainder from the Thinking model, controlled by a single parameter. Section 3.3 examines full protection, where the operator transfers only expressive complements and forms a four-variant family differing solely in retained components—laying the groundwork for the interpretability analysis in Section 5 .
blocks.zh: 本节分三步发展方法. 第3.1节询问思维模式与其 不思考的对等方在重量空间,发现功能差异大多在非思考模式的占领方向之外. 第3.2节将这一发现转换成一个操作员,保留非思维模型的主要光谱方向,同时从由单一参数控制的思维模型中导入其余部分。 第3.3节审查了充分保护问题,即经营者转移的只是表达性的补充,形成一个仅保留部分的四变种家庭——为第5节的解释性分析奠定了基础。

blocks.en: 3.1 Insight: Where the Thinking Difference Lives
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 透视:思维差异存在的地方

blocks.en: Let W 0 W_{0} and W t W_{t} denote the weights of a paired Non-thinking and Thinking checkpoints from the same model family. The split is stable across the middle and late layers, while the parameter-space and function-space measures consistently show that the component inside S accounts for much of the Frobenius energy but far less of the functional change, while the complementary component has similar shares under both measures. blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en: We evaluate Spectral Null-Space Swap on paired Non-thinking and Thinking checkpoints from the Qwen3 family [ 4 ] . Our evaluation covers text, vision–language, and audio reasoning tasks. Specifically, we use Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-30B-A3B, Qwen3-VL-2B, Qwen3-VL-4B, Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B as our backbone models [ 5 , 6 ] . This design evaluates both cross-modal generalization and compatibility with dense and MoE architectures. We report pass@1 for single-sample correctness and avg@4 for average performance over four generations. Additional model configurations are provided in Appendix B.1 .

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results: Cross-Modal Accuracy–Efficiency Trade-offs
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果:跨模式准确度-效率 权衡

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that our method consistently provides a favorable accuracy–efficiency trade-off across text, vision–language, and audio reasoning. Compared with Non-thinking models, it substantially improves reasoning while maintaining markedly shorter outputs than Thinking models. On text tasks, our method recovers most Thinking gains—and exceeds them on several benchmarks—while shortening chains of thought. Across vision–language and audio domains, it frequently achieves the lowest token usage among merging baselines while preserving competitive accuracy. Thus, Spectral Null-Space Swap transfers reasoning capability without the full decoding overhead. Compared with TIES and MI-0.8, our method exhibits a superior Pareto frontier; additional benchmarks and detailed trade-off analyses appear in Appendix B.2 .
blocks.zh: 表1显示,我们的方法一贯提供有利的准确性,在文本、视觉语言和音频推理之间实现效率的权衡。 与非思考模型相比,它大大改进了推理,同时保持了明显短于思考模型的产出. 在文字任务方面,我们的方法在缩短思想链的同时,恢复了大多数思考成果——并在几个基准上超过这些成果。 在整个视觉-语言和音频领域,它经常在合并基线中达到最低的象征性使用率,同时保持竞争性的准确性。 因此,Spectraral Null-Space Swap在没有完全解码的间接费用的情况下转移推理能力. 与TIES和MI-0.8相比,我们的方法显示了一个优越的Pareto前沿;额外的基准和详细的权衡分析见附录B.2。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we investigate where, in weight space, a Thinking model differs functionally from its corresponding Non-thinking model
and propose Spectral Null-Space Swap ( S 3 S^{3} ) , a training-free method for efficient reasoning. We identify a structural asymmetry between parameter energy and functional impact: the component of the difference aligned with the Non-thinking model’s dominant singular subspace contains substantial parameter energy but induces weak functional changes, while the complementary null-space component drives the core functional shifts. By preserving the Non-thinking model inside its primary spectral subspace and importing only the Thinking model’s complementary components, S 3 S^{3} reduces reasoning token overhead without sacrificing performance. Across 2B–30B dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models and text, vision-language, and audio reasoning benchmarks, S 3 S^{3} consistently improves the accuracy–efficiency trade-off. Across more than 25 evaluation settings, it reduces generated tokens by approximately 30% while maintaining or improving accuracy over Thinking baselines. Mechanistically, null-space projection produces lower attention entropy and more concentrated attention, which we explain through local stationarity. Overall, S 3 S^{3} provides both a geometric view of post-training weight difference and a simple training-free approach to efficient reasoning.

blocks.en: Figures 7 – 9 visualize the accuracy–token trade-off across all evaluated benchmarks. Each panel jointly plots the Instruct, Thinking, TIES, MI-0.8, and S 3 -0.8 models for the corresponding model family and benchmark; for LLM and vision–language settings, different model scales are displayed in the same coordinate system.

blocks.en: Across modalities, the Thinking model often provide strong reasoning performance but occupy the high-token region of the plots. In contrast, the Instruct model are generally located in low-cost regions but may sacrifice accuracy on more difficult reasoning tasks. S 3 -0.8 frequently moves toward the desirable upper-left region relative to Thinking: it reduces output length while retaining competitive reasoning performance. The results consistently show that S 3 can recover a substantial portion of Thinking-model capability without inheriting its full chain-of-thought overhead.
blocks.zh: 在整个模式中,思维模式往往提供有力的推理性能,但占据了地块的高地。 相比之下,教程模型一般位于低成本地区,但可能牺牲更困难的推理任务的准确性. S3-0.8经常向理想的左上方区域移动,而不是思维:它缩短产出长度,同时保留竞争性推理性能。 这些结果始终表明,S 3可以恢复相当一部分思维模型能力,而不继承其整个思维链间接费用。

blocks.en: Compared with TIES and MI-0.8, S 3 -0.8 often occupies a complementary operating point. TIES or MI-0.8 can provide stronger accuracy on particular benchmarks, whereas S 3 -0.8 frequently achieves lower token usage at comparable performance. This behavior is particularly useful in settings where inference cost or response latency is constrained. The multimodal plots further indicate that this trade-off is not limited to text-only reasoning: similar accuracy–efficiency patterns appear in vision–language and audio reasoning, despite their distinct input modalities and generation characteristics.
blocks.zh: 与TIES和MI-0.8相比,S 3-0.8经常占据互补的操作点. TIES或MI-0.8可以使特定基准更准确,而S 3-0.8经常在可比较的性能下达到较低的象征性使用。 这种行为在推断成本或反应延迟性受到限制的环境下特别有用. 多式联运图进一步表明,这种取舍不仅限于文本推理:类似的精确度-效率模式出现在视觉语言和音频推理中,尽管其输入模式和生成特点不同。

blocks.en: Together, these results demonstrate that spectral null-space swap offers a controllable post-hoc mechanism for efficient reasoning without additional training or decoding-time modification.
blocks.zh: 这些结果共同表明,光谱空空位互换为高效推理提供了可控的后热机制,无需额外的训练或解码时间修改.

blocks.en: B.3 Additional Ratio-Sweep Results.
blocks.zh: B.3 额外比率审查结果。

blocks.en: Table 2 and Table 9 extend the protected-subspace-ratio ablation from the dense Qwen3-4B model to the MoE Qwen3-30B-A3B model and the Qwen3-VL-2B/4B models. These results show that the ratio ρ \rho remains an effective control variable across both architecture types and modalities. Recall that a smaller ρ \rho protects fewer leading singular directions of the Non-thinking model and consequently transfers a larger complementary component from the Thinking model. This typically increases the capacity for extended reasoning, while larger values of ρ \rho retain more of the efficient Non-thinking-model behavior.
blocks.zh: 表2和表9将保护-子空间-射电衰竭从密集的Quen3-4B模型扩展至MOE Quen3-30B-A3B模型和Quen3-VL-2B/4B模型. 这些结果表明,比率 à\rho 仍然是结构类型和模式的有效控制变量。 回顾一个较小的\rho保护较少的非思维模式的主要单一方向,从而从思维模式转移一个更大的互补部分。 这通常会提高扩展推理的能力,而à\rho的更大价值则保留更多的高效的非思维模式行为.

blocks.en: The detailed results reveal a consistent but benchmark-dependent accuracy–efficiency trade-off. On the text models, decreasing ρ \rho often improves performance on challenging mathematical reasoning tasks, but generally incurs longer generations. For example, lower ratios yield stronger AIME25 performance for both Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B, whereas larger ratios frequently minimize token usage. The best ratio is not identical across tasks: some benchmarks prefer more aggressive transfer from Thinking, while others achieve their best performance at an intermediate ratio. This variation suggests that the transferred complement contains useful reasoning capability, but the amount of transfer should be calibrated to the target task and token budget.
blocks.zh: 详细结果显示,准确性与效率之间有一贯的但取决于基准的权衡。 在文本模型上,递减 $ \rho 往往会提高在挑战数学推理任务上的性能,但一般需要更长的世代. 例如,较低的比率使Qune3-4B和Qune3-30B-A3B的AIME25性能更强,而较大的比率往往尽量减少象征性使用。 各项任务的最佳比例并不相同:一些基准更倾向于从思维中进行更积极的转移,而另一些基准则以中间比例实现最佳业绩。 这一变化表明,调用的补充包括有用的推理能力,但调用的数量应当与目标任务和象征性预算相符。

blocks.en: A similar pattern holds for vision–language reasoning. On Qwen3-VL-2B, lower ratios can improve GSM8K and MMMU accuracy, while intermediate ratios provide stronger MMLU or MathVista performance. On Qwen3-VL-4B, different tasks again favor different ratios: for instance, ρ = 0.8 \rho=0.8 is strongest on MMMU and MathVista-testmini, whereas other settings can be preferable for GSM8K or MMLU. Thus, the ratio does not merely control a single global accuracy metric; it exposes a flexible operating range that can adapt to different reasoning demands.
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言推理也有类似的模式。 在Qune3-VL-2B上,较低的比值可以提高GSM8K和MMU的精度,而中间比值提供更强的MMLU或MathVista性能. 在Qwen3-VL-4B上,不同的任务再次倾向于不同的比例:例如, ^ = 0.8\rho= 0.8 在MMMU 和 MathVista-testmini 上最强, 而其他的设置对于GSM8K 或 MMLU 来说更可取. 因此,该比率并不仅仅控制一个单一的全球准确度指标;它暴露出一个能够适应不同推理需求的灵活操作范围.

blocks.en: Overall, these results support two conclusions. First, the effectiveness of spectral subspace swap is not restricted to a single dense language model, but transfers to MoE and multimodal architectures. Second, ρ \rho offers a practical post-hoc mechanism for selecting an appropriate accuracy–cost operating point without retraining or changing the decoding procedure. We use ρ = 0.8 \rho=0.8 as the default setting in the main experiments because it provides a robust balance between reasoning performance and generation efficiency across the evaluated model families, while the complete ratio sweeps offer additional operating points for budget-sensitive deployment.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些结果支持两个结论。 首先,光谱子空间互换的有效性并不限于单一的密度语言模型,而是转移到MOE和多式联运架构. 第二,在不进行再培训或改变解码程序的情况下,为选择适当的准确性-成本操作点提供了一个实用的后编码机制。 我们使用 $ = 0.8\rho= 0.8作为主要实验的默认设置,因为它在被评价的模型家族的推理性能和生成效率之间提供了有力的平衡,而完整的比例扫描为预算敏感部署提供了额外的操作点.
